5047.title: [skia-sync] Merge Chrome M152 GlyphData fix
5047.body:
[skia-sync] Merge Chrome M152 GlyphData fix (#5047)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/358

Advance release/4.152.x to mono/skia merge commit
723c5a03a7d18de5fb1a041e6cae2f09c4cb3c7e.

The upstream GlyphData fix prevents Ganesh and Graphite from recording an
atlas generation after a partial glyph-vector update. Glyphs from an earlier
flush may have been evicted, so treating the partial update as a complete
generation could take the atlas fast path with stale locations.

Record the matching chrome/m152 upstream commit in cgmanifest.json and point
the submodule gitlink at the actual two-parent mono/skia merge rather than the
reviewed PR head. The guarded repin verified that the merge contains the
reviewed commit and has an identical native tree, so it introduces no further
native changes after the completed review.

The final parent diff changes only externals/skia and cgmanifest.json. This
preserves the M152 package and ABI versions without managed wrappers,
generated bindings, C API exports, dependency pins, or test-source changes.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
